title: SimpleClaims
description: The simplist and most easily to modify claims plugin there is
body:
THE MOST SIMPLE CLAIMS PLUGIN!

REQUIRES JAVA 21+ ONLY!

Allows players to protect their builds and land from being griefed, all from a simple command.

### _**COMMANDS**_
- **Claiming: /claim <radius> makes a square around you, or right-click a block with a golden shovel for the same thing. Left-click then right-click two different spots with the shovel to claim a custom rectangle instead.
- 
- Trust tiers: /trust (build), /actrust (redstone — buttons, levers, doors, repeaters, etc.), /ctrust (containers — chests, furnaces, hoppers, etc.), each with matching un/ac un/c un removal commands. Build trust automatically includes the other two.
- 
- PvP: /claimpvp allow or /claimpvp deny toggles it for whichever claim you're standing in.
- 
- Protection: block break/place, all explosions (creepers, TNT, beds, withers, end crystals...), fire spread, lava/water flowing in, endermen/mob block-changes, vehicle damage, and hanging-item breaks are all blocked inside claims unless you're trusted.
- 
- Claim block economy: everything in config.yml — starting blocks, how many you earn, how often (default: 100/hour), max cap, whether offline players accrue too.
- **


### **_PERMISSIONS_**
simpleclaims.claim
Use all standard commands (/claim, /trust, /actrust, /ctrust, /claimpvp, etc.) and the golden shoveltrue — everyone has it

simpleclaims.admin
Use /scadmin (reload, setblocks, delete) and override owner-only checks (e.g. can /unclaim or /trust on someone else's claim)op

simpleclaims.bypass
Ignore claim protection entirely — build, break, use containers/redstone, PvP, anywhere, even in claims you don't ownop
